Summary: To log in with my policy number and an OTP
Description:
As a policy holder, I want to log in with my policy number and an OTP, so that only I can raise claims on my policy.

Acceptance criteria:
- Given policy POL-MOT-7781 is active and registered to mobile 98400xxxxx When I enter the policy number and the correct OTP Then I see my policy dashboard
- Given I have requested an OTP When I enter a wrong OTP three times Then login is blocked for 15 minutes and I see 'Too many attempts'

Summary: To register a motor claim with incident date, place and description
Description:
As a policy holder, I want to register a motor claim with incident date, place and description, so that my claim is started without visiting a branch.

Acceptance criteria:
- Given I am logged in with an active motor policy When I enter incident date 10-Nov-2026, place and description and submit Then a claim number like CLM-2026-000123 is shown and sent by SMS
- Given I am registering a motor claim When I enter an incident date after today Then I see 'Incident date cannot be in the future' and the claim is not submitted
- Given my policy expired before the incident date When I submit the claim Then I see 'Policy was not active on the incident date' and the claim is not created

Summary: To register a health claim for a hospital stay
Description:
As a policy holder, I want to register a health claim for a hospital stay, so that I can claim reimbursement online.

Acceptance criteria:
- Given I have an active health policy When I enter hospital, admission and discharge dates and submit Then the claim is created with status 'Registered'
- Given I am registering a health claim When the discharge date is before the admission date Then I see 'Discharge date must be on or after admission date'

Summary: To save a half-filled claim as a draft
Description:
As a policy holder, I want to save a half-filled claim as a draft, so that I can finish it later.

Acceptance criteria:
- Given I have filled half of the motor claim form When I tap 'Save draft' Then the draft appears under 'My drafts' and can be reopened for 30 days

Summary: To upload photos and PDFs of my documents from my phone
Description: As a policy holder, I want to upload photos and PDFs of my documents from my phone, so that I don't have to courier papers.

Summary: To see a checklist of documents still needed for my claim
Description: As a policy holder, I want to see a checklist of documents still needed for my claim, so that I submit everything in one go.

Summary: To see uploaded documents next to the claim
Description: As a claims officer, I want to see uploaded documents next to the claim, so that I can assess without asking for files by email.

Summary: To see the current status and next step of my claim
Description: As a policy holder, I want to see the current status and next step of my claim, so that I don't need to call the helpline.

Summary: To see the history of status changes with dates
Description: As a policy holder, I want to see the history of status changes with dates, so that I know how long each step took.

Summary: To message the claims officer from the claim page
Description: As a policy holder, I want to message the claims officer from the claim page, so that my questions are kept with the claim.

Summary: To get an SMS and email when my claim is approved or rejected
Description: As a policy holder, I want to get an SMS and email when my claim is approved or rejected, so that I know the decision immediately.

Summary: To see the settled amount and any deductions explained
Description: As a policy holder, I want to see the settled amount and any deductions explained, so that I understand what I was paid.

Summary: To download the settlement letter as PDF
Description: As a policy holder, I want to download the settlement letter as PDF, so that I have proof for my records.

Summary: To register a claim on behalf of a walk-in customer
Description: As a branch agent, I want to register a claim on behalf of a walk-in customer, so that customers without smartphones are also served.
